what: Run one step of a loaded spec for one unit: start its command or model task, read exit 0 with JSON or exit 75, evaluate every done_when check, move to to_state_ok or to_state_fail, and save the run state so a restart resumes at the same step.
expectations: Exit 75 leaves the state unchanged and records 'not now'.
A step whose done_when check fails moves to to_state_fail and applies on_fail (retry count, then escalate, park, ask-owner or fail).
Run state survives a restart: the next call continues from the saved state.
A step with home pipeline goes through the existing fleet bridge; no new shell-out path is added.
